owner_and_source: MobilityData (github.com/MobilityData/mobility-database-catalogs) -- the Mobility Database catalogue of GTFS and GTFS-Realtime sources, published as a single flat CSV export at storage.googleapis.com/mdb-csv/sources.csv (the target of the project's own https://bit.ly/catalogs-csv short link). No API key, no registration.
license_and_commercial_rights: Apache-2.0. Verified at acquisition time two ways: the repository LICENSE file at raw.githubusercontent.com/MobilityData/mobility-database-catalogs/main/LICENSE is the Apache License 2.0 text, and the GitHub repository metadata API reports spdx_id 'Apache-2.0'. COMMERCIAL USE IS PERMITTED, including redistribution and derivative works, subject to Apache-2.0's conditions: retain the licence and copyright notice, state changes, and carry any NOTICE file. NOTE THE SCOPE LIMIT: Apache-2.0 covers the CATALOGUE -- the list of feeds and their metadata -- and NOT the agency feeds it points at, each of which carries its own separate terms (see data/acquired/US_OPEN_DATA_SURVEY.md; the CTA developer licence is a worked example of an agency feed whose terms are NOT rights-clean for this product).
geography: global, with the United States as the largest single-country block (1,166 US GTFS-static entries and 445 US GTFS-Realtime entries in the vintage acquired)
time_coverage: current register (continuously maintained upstream); a point-in-time snapshot of the catalogue, not a time series
schema_and_format: CSV, ~3,362 rows x 27 columns: mdb_source_id, data_type (gtfs | gtfs-rt), entity_type (vp | tu | sa for realtime), location.country_code/subdivision_name/municipality, provider, name, static_reference, urls.direct_download, urls.latest, urls.license, urls.authentication_type (0 = none, 1 = key in query param, 2 = key in header), urls.api_key_parameter_name, bounding box, status (blank/active | deprecated | inactive | development), features. The authentication_type column is what makes this operationally decisive here: it is the machine-readable answer to 'which US realtime feeds can Milexium poll with no paid or registered key', which is the ADR-0035 observation-entity supply question and this packet's free-sources-only constraint in one field.
update_frequency: continuous upstream (community-maintained); re-pull on demand, not scheduled. source_checksum is null -- trust-on-first-use, the register changes as feeds are added and deprecated.
canonical_contract: none-yet -- a feed registry, not observational data. It is Connect-layer input that governs which feeds themis/connect/gtfs_realtime.py and the GTFS-static adapters can legitimately be pointed at, and which of those need a per-feed rights review first.

quality_tests.name: header_has_data_type_and_authentication_type
quality_tests.description: first line carries data_type and urls.authentication_type -- the two columns the feed-selection use depends on

quality_tests.name: contains_us_gtfs_and_gtfs_rt_rows
quality_tests.description: the export contains both gtfs and gtfs-rt rows, and US rows are present

acceptance_threshold: downloads, is CSV, > 500 KB, > 2,000 data rows, and both gtfs and gtfs-rt data types appear.
retention_and_deletion: retain: small, and it is the index that makes every future feed acquisition a governed rather than ad-hoc choice. Cheaply reproducible upstream.
